        return "\u282C" + content_braille + "\u282D" + "\u282E"
    if node.tag.endswith("mroot"):

        roots = list(node)
        if len(roots) != 2:
            # if only one, assume 2
            denominator = "".join(roots[0].itertext()).strip()
            root_index = "2"

            root_index = "".join(roots[1].itertext()).strip()

    elems = list(node)

def process_node(node):
    """Dispatch based on node type."""
    tag = node.tag
    if tag.endswith("mn"):
        return process_number(node)
    if tag.endswith("mfrac"):
        return process_mfrac(node)
    if tag.endswith("msqrt") or tag.endswith("mroot"):
        return process_function(node)
    return "".join(process_node(child) for child in node)

        root = ET.Element("root")
